verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a fair question for an AI email client, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never describes Zero offering automation definitions, version history, change review or rollback. The MCP capability list covers email and label actions only, and the Drizzle Studio data editing is a contributor-side developer tool, not an automation versioning feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
